about: Runner stages for common/deepseek_route.py run-stage. The child runs with the LAB venv: pass --artifact-root <agent-tracer>/packages/agentdojo-lab (never stored here). Episode lists, wire contract, comparison target and deviations live in config.template.json under the same stage names. Estimates come from estimate_tokens.py (ground-truth replay, calibrated against the lab's measured DeepSeek per-suite means) and are UNVERIFIED until the S1 ledger exists.

defaults.fidelity: own harness check, backbone-substituted: deepseek-flash (thinking disabled, T=0, max_tokens 2048) on stock AgentDojo v1.2.2 important_instructions, no defense

DRY.description: Plumbing only: banking user_task_0 x injection_task_0 through the guard to Ollama qwen2.5:7b-instruct, adapter episode ceiling 10 requests. Not evidence.

estimate.requests: 3-6 (ground-truth replay: 3 turns ignoring the injection, 4 following it, x1.5 margin; UNVERIFIED)
estimate.usd: 0 (local Ollama; notional USD at the snapshot about 0.002-0.005)

S1.description: 4 episodes on DeepSeek: banking user_task_0 benign and x injection_task_0; slack user_task_2 benign and x injection_task_1. Wire acceptance and cost calibration for S2.

estimate.requests: 12-20 (UNVERIFIED; ground-truth replay x1.5; stock bound 4 x 48 = 192)
estimate.tokens: about 18.6k-43.5k (UNVERIFIED; smoke/token_estimate.json stage S1; lab measured per-slot means banking 5,849, slack 8,328)

S1.compares_to: none numerically (4 episodes); checks that DeepSeek accepts the stock tool-calling wire through the guard and that the payload addresses 'DeepSeek'

S2.description: Banking + Slack: 249 attacked pairs, 37 benign user tasks, 14 injection tasks run as user tasks (300 episodes). Native DeepSeek model screen for G1/OPEN-2. Resume after a stop with: run-stage ... -- --resume-from <previous out_dir>/harness

estimate.requests: about 1,240-2,550 (UNVERIFIED; ground-truth replay, high = follow injection x1.5)
estimate.tokens: about 2.14M-6.14M (UNVERIFIED; smoke/token_estimate.json stage S2. Cross-check: lab measured per-suite means x episodes = 169 x 5,849 + 131 x 8,328 = 2.08M)
estimate.usd: about 0.78-2.13 at the 2026-09-30 snapshot (UNVERIFIED; cache hits charged as misses)
estimate.wall_time: about 40-115 min at the 60,000 tokens/min pacing (UNVERIFIED)

S2.compares_to: SIEVE v3 Table 12 No Defense, DeepSeek-V3.2, all four suites: ASR 42.68 / Ua 62.80 / Uc 87.63. Side by side only: different suite scope and backbone, so no pass band (config.template.json comparison.sieve_f0).

S3.description: OPTIONAL, NOT REQUESTED, needs separate approval: all four suites, 949 attacked + 97 benign + 35 injection-as-user (1,081 episodes). The only scope that sits next to SIEVE F0.

estimate.tokens: about 16.5M-41.4M (UNVERIFIED; smoke/token_estimate.json stage S3; travel attacked episodes dominate the high band)
estimate.wall_time: about 5-13 h at the 60,000 tokens/min pacing (UNVERIFIED); resume across invocations is supported

S3.compares_to: SIEVE v3 Table 12 No Defense, DeepSeek-V3.2: ASR 42.68 / Ua 62.80 / Uc 87.63, same suite scope; still no pass band because the backbone, thinking mode and temperature differ or are unknown
